description.text:
A concept pack released on 16 September 2016 for the Pokémon Card Game's 20th anniversary, which fell on 20 October 2016. Its wrapper recreates that of the first Expansion Pack of 1996, and its cards bring back that set's frames and illustrations, from Charizard to Pikachu, joined by Pokémon-EX of Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise in a 20th-anniversary style and new M Pokémon and BREAK Evolutions such as Ninetales BREAK. Packs held ten cards. The cards are numbered to 87, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters and three extras, Exeggutor, Imakuni?'s Doduo and Here Comes Team Rocket!. In English most of its cards came out in Evolutions in November 2016.

The cards play under the XY BREAK rules of the time and have the current card back, so they mix with XY cards. The old layout gained a Basic mark, Pokémon Powers became Abilities, Weakness and Resistance show their numbers, Trainer cards read TRAINER'S and are labeled Item or Supporter, and the cards' power was adjusted to the XY BREAK series.
